abstract: We have studied effects of sodium butyrate on embryonal carcinoma F9 cell differentiation. In the presence of sodium butyrate, F9 cells underwent rapid and drastic morphological changes and expressed marked increases in mRNA levels of various differentiation markers. When sodium butyrate was removed from the cultures, all the examined phenotypes of F9 cell differentiation rapidly reverted to the characteristics of undifferentiated stem cells. However, under the same conditions, when cycloheximide or actinomycin D was added to the cultures, such phenotypic reversion was not observed, but high mRNA levels of the differentiation markers as well as altered cell morphology were retained. These results indicated that the effects of sodium butyrate on induction of teratocarcinoma cell differentiation were reversible and that de novo syntheses of some mRNA(s) and protein(s) were necessary for the reversion of differentiated cells to stem cells.
abstract_ja: 我々は、胎児性癌細胞F9の分化に対する酪酸ナトリウムの効果を検討した。酪酸ナトリウム存在下では、F9細胞は急速かつ顕著な形態変化を示し、種々の分化マーカーのmRNA量が著明に増加した。酪酸ナトリウムを除去すると、分化した表現型はすべて未分化幹細胞の特徴へと速やかに復帰した。一方、シクロヘキシミドやアクチノマイシンDを添加した場合には、このような表現型の復帰は認められず、分化マーカーの高いmRNA量と細胞形態の変化は維持された。これらの結果から、奇形癌細胞の分化誘導に対する酪酸ナトリウムの効果は可逆的であり、分化細胞が幹細胞へ復帰するためには、一部のmRNAおよびタンパク質の新規合成が必要であることが示された。
